# What share of its court-hours does a padel club need to sell to break even, and how much cash does the ramp-up eat?

> Free padel club profit calculator: courts, peak and off-peak court-hour prices, utilisation, members, coaching, food and drink, staffing, rent and a loan become monthly profit, break-even court utilisation, the price change that hits a target margin, the ramp-up cash reserve and payback. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
